english.title: Employer failing to preserve duplicate record sheet

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the employer of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) as a driver and having detached duplicates of the weekly record sheets from the driver's record book pursuant to regulation 8(2)(b) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987, failed to preserve those sheets for a period of one year from **(..SPECIFY DATE..), the day on which that book was returned to you pursuant to regulation 8(3) of the Regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 11(2) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who employed **(..SPECIFY DRIVER..) as a driver of a goods vehicle and who had detached duplicate copies of the weekly record sheets from the driver's record book, failed to preserve those sheets for a period of one year from **(..SPECIFY DATE..), being the date on which the book was returned by that driver.
